raw_record.question_text:
The experiment involving fruit flies produced the following results:

1) The wing phenotype has wild type (normal wings) and mutant type (vestigial wings or crumpled wings).

2) The body color phenotype has dominant type (gray body) and mutant type (black body).

Based on the above information, the genetic distance of these two pairs of alleles in the fruit fly linkage group is ____ genetic units (map unit).

method.method_draft: First describe the image contents: it lists four fruit-fly phenotype classes with counts and defines wing and body-color alleles. Treat the two largest classes, 525 vestigial gray and 555 crumpled black, as parental classes. Treat the two smaller classes, 75 crumpled gray and 45 vestigial black, as recombinant classes. Add recombinants: 75 + 45 = 120. Add all offspring: 525 + 555 + 75 + 45 = 1200. Compute recombination frequency = 120/1200 × 100 = 10%, so the genes are 10 map units apart.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中左侧列出四类果蝇后代表型及数量：525 只 vestigial, gray-bodied flies；555 只 crumpled, black-bodied flies；75 只 crumpled, gray flies；45 只 vestigial, black-bodied flies。图中右侧给出等位基因说明：V = vestigial，v = crumpled，G = gray，g = black。再推理：按照题目给定方法，两类数量最大的后代为亲本型，即 525 只残翅灰身和 555 只皱翅黑身。两类数量较小的后代为重组型，即 75 只皱翅灰身和 45 只残翅黑身。重组个体数 = 75 + 45 = 120。总后代数 = 525 + 555 + 75 + 45 = 1200。重组频率 = 120 / 1200 × 100% = 10%。遗传距离以重组百分率表示，所以两对等位基因相距 10 个遗传单位。

raw_record.original_question:

1) 翅膀表型存在野生型（正常翅膀）和突变型（残留翅膀或皱巴巴翅膀）。

2) 体色表型存在主导型（灰色身体）和突变型（黑色身体）。

根据上述信息，这两对等位基因在果蝇连锁群中的遗传距离是____个遗传单位（map unit）。
